info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Rates-v2-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the current mortgage loan rates, allowing users to retrieve up-to-date information essential for borrowers and financial institutions. It serves as a vital resource for lenders, brokers, and consumers evaluating mortgage options. By querying the rates, users can compare offerings and make informed decisions about loan applications. This streamlined access to mortgage rate data supports better financial planning and market analysis.

get.summary: Retrieve the current interest rate for loans.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest interest rate applicable to loans. It is important for users seeking to understand their potential borrowing costs based on market conditions.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to obtain the loan rate information based on the specified parameters. Ensure that the data provided conforms to the expected schema for accurate results.
